eps.d: Byker Grove is an alternative place to be. When Julie's family moved from London to Newcastle she called the city a horrible dump, but then she met the crowd at Byker Grove.
Donna is furious when her dad accuses kids from Byker Grove of stealing motorbikes, but he's right, and Gill's joy ride leads to a bloody nose.
Gill's upset because Julie's been banned: Donna's delighted because she'll be the star of the show.

The kids from the Grove set off for a day's skateboarding, while Donna is becoming insufferable about her forthcoming appearance as a model in a charity fashion show, but all does not go according to plan.
When the kids set off on their long-awaited camping trip, the delights of the open-air and life under canvas seem to make the older kids distinctly frisky.
A hard choice faces Julie who has to come to terms with the fact that her parents are breaking up; Winston is faced with the imminent arrival in Newcastle of Kelly, the girl he met at camp.
Six months have passed and things are changing fast at Byker Grove. Today is Donna's birthday but before the party she has to find out why her mam broke her promise.
Byker Grove's honour is at stake in the football match with Denton Burn but no one is betting on the outcome.
Donna's dad blows his top when she rolls back home with a hangover.
Gill can't believe his eyes when Julie presents him with her new image. On a boat trip to the Farne Islands, Nicola runs into a couple of thugs.
Spuggie's spying career comes down to earth with a bang.
Who is the thief at Byker Grove? Geoff sets a trap. It's Gill's big day but will he get the prized job? Debbie is terrified in the video room.
Why does Carl always trail the Byker Grove girls? Winston gives Debbie nightmares; more money goes missing from Geoff's box; Spuggie returns to the shed and is sent on a mysterious errand...
Where is Spuggie taking Beckett and what does he want with her? The radio lads recognise an unusual talent in Kelly. Gill's unexpected visitor asks something outrageous.
Donna is back, and hates what she hears about Charley.
Julie's lie is uncovered. Kelly's first agony aunt call is not what she expects. Charley and Robert get carried away - in different directions.
Charley's big chance of fame - will she break the record? Gill is put through the mangle by Julie and her mother! The Grove gang reveal all - not exactly what Geoff expected.
Gill's split with Julie makes him wild. Spuggie and Fraser settle in at Speedy's and meet a new face. Jan is back.
The Dobsons' party is rudely interrupted. Will Charley's record get released? And there's double trouble for Gill.

The Dobsons go to a leek show where Nicola meets someone green. The Bells plan a surprise. A hit-and-run accident is reported in the paper. Winston is worried. Geoff tries to help Duncan with his addiction.
Gill is asked about the car respray. Charley returns to the Riverfront Club to find out about her record.
Kelly confronts Carl. Donna deceives Kirsten. The return match looms with Denton Burn. Gill gets a threat and makes a confession
Kirsten goes missing but Nicola lends a hand. Gwen gets a fright, the Grovers confront Denton Burn, Winston makes some discoveries, and Gill makes a fatal mistake.

Gill's death brings Julie back to Newcastle, and at the Grove they are thinking of ways to raise money for Gill's memorial. Nicola is involved in a Green Brigade meeting. Robert concentrates on walking again. Joanne wants her brother to join her from Hong Kong.
Carl confesses to blackmailing Gill, and Julie returns to London. Joanne's 'brother' is an imposter. Winston visits Tabitha at the camp to talk about Gill's death.
Strange sightings at the Grove. Winston talks to the vicar about Gill's death. The Grovers are planning an acid house party.
Brad leaves Alison. The police are questioning Paul about the car stickers. Winston's photo of Gill goes missing.
Duncan, PJ, and Speedy start to investigate the strange events at the Grove. Charley gets another red rose, but Donna makes her give it to her.
Lou meets Scott. Duncan, Speedy, Fraser, and PJ practice signalling and are joined by Debbie and Jemma.
Nicola is worried about Paul and thinks the police are looking for her. Duncan and PJ plan an acid house disco at the Grove.
Skerrett tells Nicola the truth about Paul. The chess tournament takes place at the Grove, and Spuggie is so absorbed she forgets to say goodbye to Joanne.

Speedy is in love with Charley and dreams about her. Alison suggests he tries expressing his feelings through poetry. Robert is not getting on with his walking as well as he should and tells Lou he will have to go to a specialist.
Fraser meets Lee whilst looking for Betty and gets him to agree to contact him if he sees her. Donna and Lisa fall out about Jim, as Lisa thinks Donna is trying to get attention.
Donna owns up to Lisa about Jim asking for her help. Fraser saves Geoff when he falls off the roof of the Grove and hurts his arm.
Donna's broadcast goes out on the radio, and she is interviewed for TV. Geoff calls off the show after falling through the trapdoor PJ had left open.
Geoff receives shocking news. Alison introduces two newcomers. Winston's car washing scheme runs into trouble.
Danny helps a girl fight off a mugger. Marcus and Amanda find themselves unpopular as Geoff announces that the Grove is going to close down.

Joanne has decisions to make about her future in America. Spuggie goes to California and meets Matt Bendigo, and thoughts of Marcus fade. Joanne arrives back at the Grove but finds things have changed.
Duncan is bewitched at a strange house by Leah. Speedy embarrasses Charley who returns to the recording studio. Nicola faces a mystery caller.
The Dobsons are shocked by a disappearance. Fraser's 18th birthday prompts an important decision. Lee leads Jemma towards temptation.
The girls attend auditions for the film to be made at the Grove, and Amanda, Jemma, Tessa, Charlie and Angel get through to next round.
Spuggie's father arrives back in Newcastle, Kath loses her baby, Jemma gets grounded, Angel and Noddy get confronted by cultists, and Lee sneaks into the Dobsons' bathroom to see Jemma.
The secret of Spuggie's past drives her away. Marcus disappears as something odd lands in the Bewicks' garden.
Amanda makes a play for PJ. Jemma falls out with Lee and in with the wrong crowd.

Lee asks for help when Jemma gets involved with Kevin's gang. Noddy takes Angel and brothers and sisters fishing. Marcus, PJ and Winston make another attempt at underage drinking. Spuggie confronts Campbell about the past.
Fraser takes Frew and Patsy to the Grove. Jemma is still after the star part in the film.
Nicola and Paul have been away together. Duncan tries to get Lee to join the Cult. Marcus and Amanda have their things repossessed.
Duncan's loyalty to Leah is tested. Nicola is forced to confront the truth about Paul.
A ceremony at Winter House horrifies Duncan as the Grove discover the truth about Psychandrics. Matt and Marcus provide Spuggie with a dilemma. Mega-star Creek Benton arrives at the Grove.
Alison banishes Lloyd from the Grove, but is it too late?
Duncan prepares for Mexico. Nicola and Paul are married.
PJ is revealed as blind. He does a bungee jump and finally returns to the Grove. Debbie is too upset to see him. Charlie starts on an antiwarfilm for her film society.
Charlie starts filming her film. Angel and Noddy hunt the alligator and are scared off. The band plays at PJ's birthday party and are a roaring success. They meet Kolton, a local club owner.
Kolton offers the band a gig at his club. Marcus leaves the band, and Dale joins. Debbie and Duncan grow closer whilst taking PJ out on a charity bath ride.

Charlie has upset everyone except Leah with her film. PJ still won't talk to anyone, but Patsy persuades him to pray with her by the river. The band plays their gig at the Icarus Club; it is a big success.
The Byker News reveals that the Queen Mother is to visit Newcastle. Marcus discovers that Kolton is pirating music cassettes. PJ has a frightening experience while training for his potholing trip.

Geoff agrees to put something on for the Royal visit. Frew and Dale are 'arrested' by a 'Palace Official' who turns out, in fact to be Geoff's brother-in-law. Tim arrives at the Grove full of creative ideas.
Charlie solves Dale's head lice problem. Debbie and PJ have a heart to heart and decide it would be best to split up.
PJ announces his decision to leave. Marcus introduces Amanda to his new circle, and she becomes the subject of Kolton's attentions
Gary, Alison's nephew, arrives at the Grove. Kolton gives Marcus drugs to sell for him, and Patsy and Leah play a trick on Charlie and Dale. The lads follow Tim and see him kissing Kath Dobson.
Kath is forced to tell Alan about her affair with Tim. Patsy and Leah make up with Charlie. Alfie and Ed are planning a scheme.
Marcus tries to sell speed at the Grove. Morph tells him what she thinks of him. Alfie and Ed's scheme is revealed - they enter a go-kart race. Jemma goes to see Tim.
Fran rescues Marcus. Lou is worried about Amanda. Patsy and her friend Marie go to confession. The lads spot Gary and Angel kissing.
Leah plans a murder mystery night at the Grove. Patsy worries about her approaching confirmation. Marcus finally wises up to Kolton, but spots Amanda in Aston's car.
Allan confronts Tim at Denton Burn, and Jemma confesses that nothing happened between her and Tim. Marcus searches for Amanda and eventually finds her back at their old house.
Marcus is wracked with guilt. Frew and Barney are eager to see Alfie's big sister, Anna. Angel and Noddy go scrambling but are knocked off the bike by a lorry.
Noddy is taken to hospital, and Angel promises to retrieve the bike and not tell. The New Age travellers leave the Grove, but one caravan is left behind.
Lee and Angel discover her dad's lorry loaded with antiques in his lockup. Dale is wound up about starting his period.

Angel discovers that it was not her dad driving the lorry and suspects Dave. Geoff and Duncan have a talk, and Duncan leaves the Grove to help with the TAVI club. Arran takes Patsy to his secret place - a cave on the coast.
Angel keeps calm and manages to get herself and her sister out of trouble. Gary takes Leah to the wrestling, where she rescues Dale from Killer Wells.
Patsy finds Arran, and they mount a plan to rescue his gran from the care home. Debbie leaves the Dobson house for her new job. Anna and Alfie look forward to living at the Dobson's old house.

When "Screen Teen's", which is being produced by a local TV station, accept Jemma she is thrilled to have her chance at stardom. Lessons are being learnt by Angel and we have new Grove members, brother and sister Alfie, Anna and Flora.

Angel's problems escalate to the point of being resuced by Noddy. The Turnbull househouls is still simmering and tempers are ready to boil over between Anna, Flora and Alfie. Gary is set up on a blind date with Jemma by Charlie and Lee. And a spider with a taste for milkshake gives Lee a slight scare that's to Ed.

The ""Screen Teen's"" show isn't everything that Jemma thought it would be and finally agrees to Gary's request to be her cameraman. Ed's pets are still causing problems when Patsy and Arran decide to free them in the Grove. And things start to look good for Charlie when things click for her and Lee.

The wedding arrives at last for Peter and Jean but happiness turns to diaster when Anna falls overboard on the boat. Supernatural information is heard by Anna and Alfie from their dead mother and they try to give their step-mother a go. Barney and Frew nearly send the Grovers deaf from their so called music.

""Screen Teen's"" decide that Jemma is the one and Gary is also sought after by them and go out to celebrate. More wedding days problems for Peter and Jean when on their honeymoon, Flora decides to show up at the hotel.

The celebratory meal goes well with Jemma and Gary, but what will happen now that Jemma was accidently electrocuted while helping an elderly neighbour? Anna is still trying her best to try her father's new marriage but her wild party doesn't go the way she planned.

This episode is foreshadowed by Jemma's funeral. Her ""Screen Teen's"" episode is show at the Grove as a tribute to her. Flora and Brigid get hold of the DJ equipment of Barney and Frew's which disrupts Jemma's furneral. Amanda returns and with her she brings more than one trouble.

The crowd at Denton Burns are lucky to escape alive when Dale meddles with Barney and Frew equipment. Aston turns up looking for Amands and his child. Kit and his travelling community find a new member as Patsy become more and more involved.

Noddy once again comes to the rescue, this time with Angel for Amanda. But are there feelings for Amanda that Noddy hasn't said? There must be because he sends her flowers and an invitation to the fun festival. Things turn sour though when Angel warns Amanda to stay away from Noddy. Charlie starts modelling and Lee is the first to find out.
Noddy tells Amanda that he will help her out where he can with the baby. Amanda though has more problems because Angel and Leah are planning on ganging up on her.

The chain letters are becoming more than a little problem at the Grove. Noddy convinces Amanda to go out on a date with him, but he's not interested in a relationship but Frew and Arran are left holding her baby after she up and leaves. Patsy and her friends embarress and ruin Charlie's fashion show after the girls don't realise the models are actually wearing fake furs.
After leaving the baby with Arran and Frew the children services' department comes to investigate Amanada. The green eyed monster comes out when Charlie finds out that Lee is dating another model

Amanda is overjoyed when children's services approve her as a suitable mother. Charlie is not coping well with Lee's blossoming relationship with Kelly. And Patsy gets Leah to admit it was her her phoned children's services about Amanda.
Patsy's babysitting doesn't go well when she loses the baby. Leah leaves to find her real mother. Duncan makes a visit to the Grove to get a reference from Geoff for his college application.

Duncan, who is still around, gets himself entered into a competition when Dale doesn't show up by Marie and Anna. The only problem being that he wins and they have to tell the truth. Patsy breathes easy again after the baby is found. Leah meets her real mother for the first time.

After Barney and Frew are mugged the Grove Patrol gets into gear, but they're not really interested in finding the culprits. Noddy goes to Angel to try and tell her about his situation because he needs help. While at his party Amanda has to pay a price for leaving baby Sam at home. Leah is upset when her mother doesn't want anything to do with her.

After breaking up with Kelly, Lee tries to get back with Charlie. Amanda regains custody of Sam but has to seriously think about his long term future. A disheartened Leah returns to the Grove. And Noddy loses control of his feelings for Gary when he kisses him in the cinema.

Amanda decides that the best thing to do is put Sam up for adoption. Noddy has to deal with prejudice and backlash at the Grove as the news spreads about the kiss. While at Kleethorpes Holiday Camp, Alfie, Anna and Flora meet Karen.
Angel listens to Noddy as he breaks down over his feelings for Gary and she convinces him to see the counsellor. Lee is no closer to getting back with Charlie.

Using Lee for bait Terry is finally caught over the mugging, only he comes back for revenge. Gary is still mourning the loss of Jemma and won't listened to Angel's reasoning to get his and Noddy's friendship back on track. Karen tracks Alfie to Newcastle and pays him a suprise visit.
Lou takes in a new foster child, Harry. A girl who has a tragic past. Cher, her bestfriend, comes to visit her and Frew invites them to the Grove.
Frew is released from the court on the sole condition that he leaves Newcastle, Lou arranges for him to stay with her sister in Northampton.

Teraise is angered when she discovers that a free poster of a pop band had been defaced by her newspaper deliver. She confronts him and he apologises as he was only doing it in protest for girls to start liking boy bands for their singing talent instead of how good looking they are.

Phillip is taken by Teraise to meet Geoff at the Grove. However on the way there Gruff, a wayward goat, follows them. Angered that Teraise didn't pay him any attention, Jack arranges to have Gruff taken to the slaughterhouse (which is where he was from to begin with). Teraise and Phillip save Gruff from his fate.
A sad day at the Grove for Terraise and Phillip when Gruff is killed in a racist attack on the Grove.
Terry introduces his younger brother Ben to the other Grovers. Problems follow though as their father has just been released from prison and he has no intention of going straight.

Jack and Phillip are planning to be the Gallagher brothers for the ""Stars In Your Eyes"" competition. Their first rehersal however goes a bit off as they get drunk on the alcohol that Alfie and Ed had hidden.

It's ""Stars In Our Eyes"" night at the Grove and Anne joins Sita on stage as the Eternal Sisters. Cher and Harry argue as Cher decides to perform solo as Madonna instead of performing as ABBA with Harry. Harry decides to get revenge on Cher by pulling the plug on the cassette player proving to everyone that she was miming.

Rob takes all the credit when ram-raiders are stopped by him, Terry and Ben. Tensions between Harry and Cher continue to mount and Cher ends up stealing Harry's idea for a syncromised swimming team. Meanwhile at the Pool Tournament at the Grove Terry is raving mad when Karen teams up with Rob against him and Ben. And Flora grows a conscience after she hears about Phillip and his poor life.

Rob's life goes from bad to worse after Brigid comes to him to make things up, all was going well until she finds out that Rob was hiding during the ram-raid. Flora and Anna want Phillip to appear on TV will them, he goes to Terraise and Jack for help. And Sian catches Cher stealing from the Grove to pay for the coach she hired for the synchronised swimming.

Alfie is disappointed with the success of the Pool Tournament when Karen purposely pots the black eight meaning that Terry and Ben win. Harry is still seeking revenge on Cher and does it by terroising her. And Toon Pizza is where Brigid wins a free meal for two, but who will she inviteâ€¦?

Karen's deed turns sour when Terry learns that she lost on purpose, and he decides to break up with her. So slipping back to plan b she decides to let Rob know by anonymous letter that she cheated with the game and he of course wants a rematch. Ed has entered the lads into a soft drink competition. And Brigid has decided to invite Cher to the free meal leaving a very angry Harry.

Cher has Harry arrested for attempted murder. New blood in the Grove when Leanne arrives and becomes friends with Brigid who is fast losing herself to depression. More on Cher as Sita and Teraise try to get Cher to see things from Harry's point of view and she decides to drop the charges, but tells Harry that they will never be friends. And to finish things off, Alfie and Leanne share a kiss.

Alfie is disappointed that Leanne wants to keep their relationship a secret. Brigid is left waiting for Leanne who has gone off with Alfie, this by chance lets her get to know Terry better. Still with Brigid, and Rob wants another chance he make arrangements through Terry who 'accidently' sends her to the wrong McDonalds.

The Spacer Race is still going. Alfie is caught out bragging to his mates about what he and Leanne have been doing by Brigid who jumps to the conclusion that he raped her. Sita is turned down for a role in a local musical. Both Ben and Jack are interested in Teraise, but she's only intersted in one of them.
Ben brings a friend home from school, Ollie.

Ben takes Ollie to the Grove. They decide to break into the attic, however the rotten floorboards end their plans when Ben's arm goes through them. They tell Lou that it was Geoff fault saying that he hadn't locked the door to the attic, the plan being that they would get money for compensation.
Ollie and Ben are forced to come clean after Sian has to administer first aid to Ollie after he has an accident while climbing over the fence.
New girl Emma joins Harry and Nat against the boys of the ""Ollie's Network O"".
Alfie and Leanne get to celebrate a short-lived 3 month anniversary after the 'Ollie O' boys come looking for ""Trooper John"" who Ollie had been in contact with over the Internet.
Ollie finds out that ""Trooper John"" is actually Emma.

When the kids notice Geoff being stand-offish they decide that he must be going through a mid-life crisis. In order to cheer him up they all get together to throw him a surprise 70's party. It came complete with 'performances' by Charlie's Angels (and 'Charlie' who got a face full of cream) and the band The Who.

Ben tells Jack that he broke up with Harry and she isn't happy when she finds out. Harry submits a tape to a company offering a competition. And Ben tries to make it up with her only to kiss Cher as part of a bet he had with Ollie. Jack's birthday is coming up and they arrange to take him ten pin bowling.

Jack receives a cheque for 2,500 pounds from his Aunt Mary who has passed away. He then spends the money on a motorbike. He also makes amends with Teraise about the evening before and his birthday. Nikki's father drives her to see her mother only for her to be disappointed in her mother's denial of what happened with Mike, but she is determined to return the following day to finish sorting it…

Jack shows off his bike the rest at the Grove and takes lessons to get his learners. Teraise waits for him to call, only to have her father tell her that she isn't to ride on the bike with him. Nikki returns to speak with her mother Carol only for her to drop a bombshell on Nikki, that she will be testifying on behalf of Mike.

Ben is trying to keep up with dating both Karen and Cher but things get tricky at the art gallery and his plan is finally disguised. Teraise and Jack take the bike out, only to have it stolen. Nikki's looks through photos that were taken off her and her mother with Mike before he moved in with them. Sita doesn't know what to say to Jake when he asks her to move in with him.

Clowns R Us decide to revolt after Jake's cut is 20% and team up with Mr Jolly Wolly (Bradley) in order to prove their point with cream. Meanwhile, Ben is still avoiding Karen and Cher who are determined to exact revenge on him for two-timing them. Sita wants to prove her point with Jake and designer clothes by making an idiot of him at the mall.

Nikki's trial starts and on the second say she gives her evidence against Mike, but her testimony goes about as well as Jack's and Tereasa's. Cher starts drawing up some new designs for her Cher and Karen only to have Jake offer to manage them. Sita tells Jake that they don't want his money and that first he has to get orders; he agrees.

Nikki's mother changes her mind at the last moment during the trial to back what Nikki said. The verdict comes in as guilty. Cher is still annoyed at Sita for refusing Jake's money, and Jake is still not on speaking terms with her. Cher gets a grant for a 1000 pounds, only it actually isn't for real. Rob returns back from Australia only to get the cold treatment all round.

Greg, Ben and Ollie get into trouble with Geoff over the beer brewing and are warned not to make anymore trouble. Jack jumps Liam because he thinks he's a burglar only to find out he will be staying there. Liam avoids answering questions about anything Rob is waiting for the council to approve a fete and Geoff passes on the good news that it has been granted.
Geoff Keegan dies in a fire.

The break-in trial of when the Denwell Burn, a rival youth club, broke in is taking its toll as the future of Byker Grove is unsteady. Grove Youth Leader Paul is set up along with Matt to take the fall for the break in and although Matt can clear their name he is too frightened to speak up. Paul's father is afraid that if the truth doesn't come out that he will get a criminal record.

Akili is relieved as Matt tells the truth in court and Paul is set free with no criminal charges. Steve is less than impressed with Matt and says he will get his revenge. The following are the rulings: Matt - Reparation Order Steve - 4 months detention and training Byker Grove is reopened and both it and Denwell Burn are under Special Review.

Byker Grove gets a paint job and Matt is one on the Reparations team to do the job. The peace talks don't last very long after Matt sees Craig and heads straight for him, this after Paul has got the other members of the Grove to leave him alone. Luckily for Matt, Ben gets them apart just before they are seen.

Anjali gets a less than welcome reception from Adam and Luke who don't want to â€˜baby-sit' her. She's the new foster kid who likes to brag about anything she thinks will impress the others. However, the twins less than impressed decide to leave her behind and not take her to the Grove as they were asked to do by Lou. The Hamster Race is also on.

Unable to stay away from Leanne, Luke breaks his grounding to see her. Both he and Adam we punished for leaving Anjali behind and the blame of the broken answering machine is put on them. But Anjali is also to blame, in order to get Adam also into trouble she gets him angry and annoyed so that he leaves and then goes running to Lou.

Mukasa is still trying to fit in, but is upset when his trousers are ripped in a softball game, he tells Sarah that he and his mother left Uganda with only what they were wearing and that the trousers were his only pair. It is Eve however that decides to rally the troops to take a collection to get some things for Mukasa.
Nikki returns Ben's mobile to him at his flat but won't go inside. Tina has returned from her training course but goes unnoticed in the Grove.

The twins get stuck to clean up the club after Anjali takes off the moment Lou turns her back. Anjali has actually gone off to cry because she thinks that Lou will now send her away and she doesn't want to leave. Musaka is homesick and Sarah helps him feel more at home by finding some photos of Uganda on the web because he has none.

Nikki is leaving but soesn't have the heart to tell Ben, who gets fired from his job after he shouts at the manager thinking that the manager sacked her. Finally Matt tells Ben the truth. When Nikki finds out what Ben did she feels responsible because she didn't tell him.

The Grovers start out with their 'adventure'. Joe and Regina try flirting with each other meanwhile Leanne wants some time alone with Luke without Adam coming between them. We find out all about Musaka's family about what happened to them and why he was so freaked out when he say Dom in his outfit. Joe loses members of his team left, right and center. First Jamie and then Eve.

Eve and Jamie are rescued after Akili hears them yelling for help. Anjali helps Lou around the flat and she appears to have made a quick recovery, however as always she is up to something else. Ben has ran out of money in his flat.

In order to afford an exercise video, Stella steals her mother's credit card and when her friend Helen finds out they argue and Helen accuses her of being like her father ""a thief"". Anjali is caught out when the twins, Luke and Dominic figure out who set the pranks. The truth is known about Luke now as he finally tells Leanne about his Dyspraxia.

Emma rehearses with Fraser and Paul returns back form his trip to France and goes to find Emma only to agrue with her and Fraser sends him out the door. Dom applies to be a trainee youth leader and Ben becomes jealous. Meanwhile love is once again in the air when Joe first helps her with her paper round and then gives her a friendship brooch.

Injuries from the skateboarding competition are abundant. While Adam is lucky to have only slipped a disc, Lou warns Luke about the possibility that Adam might not be able to pursue football as a career. Anjali finally tells Adam and she and Luke get into a fight.

At the radio station both Beth and Jodie are now producers and for their first prodcast they get Sarah to interview Musaka. Eve gets a disgusting surprise when instead of getting a can of drink she receives dead hamsters instead, Stumpy blames himself and together they bury them in the woods. Stella receives a letter from her father in prison and tries to keep it secret.

Anjali is once again in the firing line with Luke as he blames her for the fire in Lou's kitchen. Upset with both Luke and Lou, Anjali tells Matt that she wants to stay and then gets the courage to tell Lou how she really feels. Luke and Adam can't agree about Anjali staying but Lou makes the final decision that she can.

Ben heads off for Tenerife in order to win back Claire. Luke is upset when Adam tells him that he'll never make it to be a professional footballer. Anjali doesn't like what Adam said and tells Leanne that Luke is going to break up with her. Regina is awe-struck with Flip's skateboarding and asks him to give her lessons. Laura tries to make Regina look like an idiot but sees through her plan.

Steve continues his reign of terror over Robert and gets him to spy on Matt. Parcels start arriving for Matt out of the blue although he suspects that Steve is somehow behind it. Meanwhile over in London, Akili has gone to talk to Juliet not knowing what he is getting into. Lesley accidently gets locked in the attic by Tina and when she sees a mouse totally freaks out.

After returning from his trip to Tenerife Ben immediately starts taking more orders for games. Luke is suspicious but does nothing. We also find out that Claire has moved on with her life and has found a new love. After a fight with Juliet's new boyfriend Julian, Akili is sporting a black eye. Dom tells Akili that he has been accepted to work at Camp America.

Steve's temper is getting worse and he hits Robert so he'll do another errand. Ben rings in sick and has to decide what to do with all the stolen games in his flat. Luke and Adam decide to visit Ben and finds the stolen games, Luke doesn't want any trouble and leaves the flat but Adam stays behind. The new youth leader of Denwell Burn is Akili.

The series returns with Ben now concerned with his future due to his criminal record. His father tries to give him a helping hand but Ben wants more out of life. Development workers are in the forest, the boundaries of the Grove are set to be changed to make room for a housing block. Regina is determined to stop them when she hears about it from Stumpy, Jamie and Robert.

Regina begins her protest of the re-development. Sadie and Bradley's dating service is going good - but only from their point of view. Ben is still trying to figure out his own future and tries for the position of Assistant Youth Leader, only to lose the position to Cher - newly returned. Ben then goes to Denwell Burn at the insistance of Lesley only not to be warmly welcomed.

Cher comes to head with Dom over his 'new ideas' for the Grove which he has picked up in America. Bradley is cracking on with his â€˜love buffet' to please his unhappy date agency Grovers. Stumpy is looking forward to it â€“ it could be his real chance to get the girl of his dreams! Adam and Luke get into trouble by heading off to the pub instead of going to the 'love bash'.

After being the job of youth leader is won by Cher, Ben is still determined that it is what he wants to do. Regina is still pulling together a group to protest against the council development. She gets Bill to agree to be tied to a tree with her so they'll be there when work is due to start in the morning.

Ben, who is working at Denwell Burn is still finding it hard to find his place as he is still less than welcome. After the tent swap incident which meant they were banned from the Grove for a while; Luke, Adam, Leanne and Anjali are allowed back on the condition that there is no more trouble. And Kate, a fan of Adam, turns up leading Leanne to get jealous when she jumps to conclusions.

Adam confesses about his unusal behaviour of late to Luke and Anjali. Leanne is regreting her night with Adam, especially when she finds out that Anjali and Luke haven't done it yet. Stumpy embarrasses himself big time in front of Hayley. And Ben is just starting to settle in working at Denwell Burn, he even goes to a show with Emma, which only stirs up feelings with Matt and Craig as they return…

The football match is on but after Adam refuses to talk to Leanne about that night, she drops the team. Despite this the girls win over the boys. Ben is still having problems in Denwell Burn - Craig who's been behind it all - then goes after Emma forcing Ben over the edge and his career hanging by a string after he attacks him.

After the warning from Eve, Akili decides to ease off drinking. Ben gets his job back after they discover the truth about Craig's hate campaign. Angry over being kicked out of the Denwell Burn Craig steals a car bent on getting revenge on Ben and Emma - and when he finds them, he drives right for them - Ben manages to push Emma out of the way, but can't avoid the car themselves.

A funeral starts of the episode without anyone knowing who it is for. Craig finally realises the consequences to his actions after the accident and Adam is determined to find him and have a go at him. Akili, who has kept his promise so far to Eve can't take it anymore with everything that has happened and drinks himself drunk - finally discovered by Matt and Emma.

Craig is still missing and Adam goes out looking for him again. Cher is desperate to cheer everyone up and decides to arrange a trip. Stumpy's secret is discover by Lucy, the other boys tease him so he decides to prove that he isn't a push over by forging his mums signiture for the Blackpool trip.

The Grovers are in Blackpool on the trip planned by Cher to lift their spirits. Stumpy loses his temper with Lucy while on a treasure hunt and tells her to get lost. She heads off upset on her own, only to come across Craig who is still wanted by the police.

After succesfully rescuing Lucy from Craig the Grovers spirits are high. Adam is still grieving over the death of Ben and his brother goes looking for him hoping to prevent him from getting revenge on Craig. He finally gets to work through everything with Luke by his side.

Stumpy is still out to impress Kate and decides that the way to do that is to change his image. Chrissie and Cher have swapped positions for a short time as part of their training - Cher going to the upperside club and Chrissie getting the Grovers. And complications and misunderstanding around Flip who is dating Laura behind Regina's back - while Regina is seeing Bill behind his back.
Leanne goes to the doctor after feeling unwell during the football competition only to have to tell Adam that she is pregnant with their child. The Grove loses the football match to Denwell Burn.

Leanne finally tells her parents about the pregnancy and they are not happy about it. Adam isn't ready to face the fact that he is going to be a father and runs off. Adam finally turns up trying not to let on to Lou who already knows and Anjali let the cat of the bag and told Luke who is ready to punch his lights out. All does not end well when Luke tells Adam he no longer has a brother.

Luke supports Leanne in an attempt to get back at Adam to whom he is still not speaking to. Lou gets Adam and Leanne to sit down with her parents, only Leanne's father wants her to get an abortion which leads to Adam running off again. A broadcast program is set up for the Grovers, from a secret location of course, while Stumpy is still giving out relationship advice, the girls have a gossip show…

A stray dog gets adopted twice, first by Mickey and the by Stumpy. Dom and Chrissie are concerned with the fallout over Leanne's pregnancy. Leanne goes to a mother's school - where she can learn about what to expect being a teenage mother. Regina and Bill make up but when he again tries to tell her about Flip and Laura she stops talking to him again - until she sees the truth first hand.

Adam realises that he needs to support Leanne more only to go and visit her to find Luke there which makes Adam feel left out. Spencer is still chasing Sadie but she is in love with Brad. In order to get back at her he breaks into the Grove to steal the computers.

Sarah is being sucked in by Spencer's lies when she accepts to go on her dream holiday after Sadie turns it down. The computer thief still hasn't been caught so Regina and Bill decide to try their hand at being detectives, while the rest of the Grove are talking about Regina leaving to go to Ireland.

The musical is on and Bill decides to suprise Regina. Sadie tells Bradley that she loves him for who he is not his money after Spencer dobs him into the police. Sarah and Spencer take off together before she finally comes to see the truth as the police catch up with them while they try to get on a ferry both ending up in the back seat of a police car.

5 months have passed. Changes are in the air as Norm doesn't like the Grove's policy and he wants stricter rules Leanne is taken to hospital by her parents, but it's just another 'test run'. Leanne's baby is almost due and she agrees to go and talk to the Grover's about being pregnant after Dom asks her, but Norm stops the conversation and bans Leanne.

The Grovers continue to protest about being banned. Spud gets told some big stories by the twins. Luke gets a job with the local paper, but is hesitant when he is told by Sam to go to the Grove and get the dirt about the Leanne's pregnancy, drinking and sex. Laura is left alone after Spencer realises he is close to being caught.

Battle of the Bands is approaching as Dogdeath continue to rehearse. But all is not well as Laura threatens to quit. Luke's article gets published in the Byker Post, but his boss has re-written it for 'better effect'. When Leanne sees the article she is devasted and takes out her anger on Adam.

Stumpy shows off his magic skills and Bill makes a speech for the position of Byker Rep. There is a new troublemaker in town in the form of Kylie who forming went to Denwell Burn. Luke confronts Sam over the article about Leanne and she tells him to get use to it if he wants to have a career as a journalist as it is all about selling newspapers.

The Byker Rep Election is still in full swing. Scott turns down Kylie when she asks him out to prove to Eve and Hayley how pathetic they are. Kylie however plans her revenge on Scott and succeeds in embarrasing him. Adam goes around to see Leanne and tries to kiss her but she tells him she isn't ready for that. Later on Leanne's water breaks.

Leanne is in the hospital and in labour. Adam rushing to the hospital quitting his job to be there with Leanne. She has a baby boy and he is named Ben. Tony Bear win the Byker Rep Election. Eve is ready to move back with her mother unless Akili stops dating Heather.

Stumpy and Sadie are not seeing eye to eye as she keeps rejecting all of his ideas while he, Sadie and Tony Bear are in charge of the Grove. Leanne returns home with baby Ben but is having trouble adjusting to her new life as a mum. Hayley and Eve are once again not on speaking terms over the Scott issue and Hayley makes is embarrassed again in front of him due to the beauty contest.

Adam makes a big mistake when he chases after Robert and Jamie after they called Ben 'ugly', while he goes after them Leanne comes across Ben unattended. Leanne gets stuck into him about being responsible. The snack bar is losing money due to Brad's Hot Stuff and to make matters worse Stumpy failed to order more stock.

Stumpy is embarrassed when a levitation act he performs with Lucy is exposed as fake. Adam is still out of work and finally gets a job as an apprentice for Keith. Luke writes an article for the Byker Post but when Lou sees it she gets angry because it is about her and the child she gave up when she was younger. Scott continues to two-time.

Because of the digger incident, Jamie and Mickey have to clean the entire Grove. Scott's plan starts to unravel as Dom speaks to both Eve and Hayley and realises what he is up to. Adam continues to work for Keith, but all is not happy.

Mickey is embarrassed when Zoe and Lucy find out that his 'rock gig' is actually an old folks home. Adam is still getting loads from Keith about his work, but things start to look up when he meets Julia. Spencer is caught and Kylie gets called into the office.

Luke receives a letter from someone who say they are Lou's son and asks Dom for help. He meets Conor McIntyre who has a birth certificate and a photo. Bill gets beaten up by Spencer who wants to keep him quiet. Heather and Akili want to take the plunge and live together but Eve and Hayley are not happy.

Lou gets to meet her grandson Damien when Conor visits again. Still grounded Kate breaks the rules to see Mark, but when Alan finds them together he loses his temper. George goes to the grove with Sarah. Bradley still isn't spending enough time with Sadie and she is insisting that he change. Scott has to watch his step as Eve and Hayley plot their revenge.

Eve and Hayley get their revenge on Scott by humilating him. A mystery admirer has sent Chrissie some creepy love letters, but they are in fact from Kylie who is setting up Bill. Sarah ends her relationship with George after she finds out he is only 15.

Anjali is feeling left out as Luke spends more time having fun with Adam than her. A Spanish beach attendant called Alejandro catches the eye of Sarah and they immediately hit it off. Later on he slips her GHB into her drink and Luke finds her after looking for Anjali to apologise. Unable to kiss Sadie, Bradley confesses to her that he thinks he could be gay.

Alejandro is confronted by Luke over the GHB, when he flees Luke helps Sarah back to his room. Anjali sees them and gets the wrong impression. Bill is confronted over the attack on Chrissie and then snubbed by the other Grovers.

Julia finds out that Adam has a child when she meets Leanne for the first time. Adam who has been enjoying himself on holiday gets landed with Benjamin as Leanne wants a break and some time to herself. Conor and Damien have moved into the Gallagher house so Lou can spend more time and get to know them better.

Chrissie decides to hold an event for Damien and Conor to raise money for them agyer Damien tells a tall tale to the other Grovers. Kate is finally out again after being grounded by her dad but she isn't meant to go near Mark but she isn't going to listen to that. Dom is told by her father to watch her and he warns Mark that he should break up with Kate.

Norm makes a one-day return ready to make a new impression. Kate is dumped by Mark via email, she tries to talk to him but he says that they are over for good. She asks him if her dad has said something and Mark tells her it was actually Dom. Luke gets himself to confess to Bradley about kissing Sadie after he thinks Anjali has already told him.

Bradley is confronted with fear after he finds his office vandalised. Sadie confesses to him that she told Luke just as he is about to go and find him Adam arrives and admits that he was responsible. Conor is waiting for the party where Lou is going to sign over her house to him. Luke goes to see Conor's ex-rugby coach, Ted Stoker, which he had seen a photo of in an old newspaper article.
